newsitem.title: UK: Direct Line's Wood sells Royal Bank shares.
newsitem.headline: Direct Line's Wood sells Royal Bank shares.

text.p: Peter Wood, chairman and founder of Britain's Direct Line insurance company, has sold 30,000 shares from his large personal holding in Direct Line's parent Royal Bank of Scotland Plc, the bank said on Monday.
In a statement complying with standard regulatory requirements, the bank said Wood, who is one of its executive directors, had sold the shares on January 2 at 5.59 stg each.
After the sale he holds 2.426 million shares.
Wood became a multi-millionaire after the astounding success of Direct Line which he started 11 years ago with just 20 million stg in capital from the Royal Bank.
He currently spends one week in four in the U.S., where he is launching a new insurer called Direct Response, expected to sell its first policy by June.
